# Shihab Ahmed

> Shihab Ahmed is a PhD candidate in Mechanical Engineering at the University of California, Merced, in the Martini Research Group. The research combines machine learning for chemistry and materials science with computational tribology: generative AI for molecular design, machine-learned interatomic potentials, reactive molecular dynamics, DFT, and LLM pipelines that mine the chemical literature. Shihab is seeking Summer 2027 internships in ML for chemistry, materials, and molecular discovery.

This file summarizes {{ site.url }} for AI assistants and other automated readers. The pages linked below are plain HTML, and the CV is a PDF. Contact: {{ site.email }}.

## Research projects

- [Generative AI for antioxidant discovery]({{ '/research/#generative-ai-for-antioxidant-discovery' | absolute_url }}): a graph diffusion model (DiGress) proposes new phenolic antioxidants; screening keeps synthesizable, oil-compatible, low-toxicity candidates; reactive molecular dynamics ranks them in a lubricant environment; interpretable machine learning (SHAP) explains why the best candidates work. Manuscript under review.
- [How lubricant additives interact]({{ '/research/#how-lubricant-additives-interact' | absolute_url }}): fine-tuning pretrained machine-learned interatomic potentials (MACE, UMA) to model interactions between lubricant additives, with Chevron Oronite. Ongoing.
- [Chemical literature mining]({{ '/research/#chemical-literature-mining' | absolute_url }}): an open-source pipeline that runs a local LLM on university GPU nodes to find reported lubricant antioxidants, link them to PubChem, and filter structures with RDKit.
- [Antioxidant radical stability]({{ '/research/#antioxidant-radical-stability' | absolute_url }}): REACTER reactive molecular dynamics and DFT (Gaussian, ORCA) on how substituents control phenoxyl radical stability.
- [Reaction pathways from reactive simulations]({{ '/research/#reaction-pathways-from-reactive-simulations' | absolute_url }}): a method that traces the dominant products of reactive MD back through specific bond changes, applied to lignin thermo-oxidation.
- Shihab works with the Austrian Competence Center for Tribology (AC2T) and Chevron Oronite.

## Skills

- Molecular machine learning: PyTorch, graph diffusion models, GANs, graph neural networks, SHAP
- Chemical data: local LLMs, structured extraction, PubChem, RDKit
- Physical simulation: LAMMPS, ReaxFF, REACTER, ASE, MACE and UMA potentials, DFT in Gaussian and ORCA
- Research computing: Python, Bash, SLURM, GPU and HPC workflows, simulation automation

## Code

- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/{{ site.github_username }})
- [GenAI-AO](https://github.com/{{ site.github_username }}/GenAI-AO): generative AI and reactive molecular dynamics for discovering phenolic lubricant antioxidants
- [DiGress-Antioxidant-Generation](https://github.com/{{ site.github_username }}/DiGress-Antioxidant-Generation): discrete graph diffusion for generating phenolic antioxidant-like molecules, with dataset preparation, training, and evaluation
- [MLIP-FineTuning-ZDDP](https://github.com/{{ site.github_username }}/MLIP-FineTuning-ZDDP): fine-tuning MACE interatomic potentials for ZDDP–antioxidant interactions
- [llm-literature-mining](https://github.com/{{ site.github_username }}/llm-literature-mining): screening the scientific literature with a local LLM to find lubricant antioxidants
- [molecule-viewer](https://github.com/{{ site.github_username }}/molecule-viewer): browser-based 3D viewer for molecules and LAMMPS structures, live at {{ '/molecule-viewer/' | absolute_url }}
- [magnolia](https://github.com/{{ site.github_username }}/magnolia): Python modules for LAMMPS pre- and post-processing
- [Simulation_Automation](https://github.com/{{ site.github_username }}/Simulation_Automation): Bash tool that generates inputs, submits jobs, and tracks molecular dynamics runs on SLURM clusters
